text_en: I write to hold on to the details that usually disappear first: a sentence overheard, a strange idea, the shape of an ordinary afternoon.
text_zh: 我寫作，是為了留住那些最容易先消失的細節：偶然聽見的一句話、一個奇怪的念頭，或一個平凡午後的形狀。

text_en: Travel changes the scale of things. A street corner can become a landmark, while a carefully made plan can disappear before breakfast.
text_zh: 旅行會改變事物的尺度。一個街角可以成為地標，而一份精心準備的計畫，也可能在早餐前就消失。

text_en: This is a place for observations, unfinished thoughts and stories I want to remember. More notes will find their way here, one page at a time.
text_zh: 這裡收藏我的觀察、尚未完成的想法，以及想要記住的故事。更多筆記會慢慢來到這裡，一頁接著一頁。
